description: Expression conformance cases (SPEC-v1 §2.3-§2.7 and W0 resolutions). Environment: `params` (document parameters). Each case: `text` (as stored), `field` (the use-site field type). Accepted cases give `canonical` (the canonical text, §2.4, a fixed point of parse+print), `type` (the static type before the use-site check: `flex`, `bool`, `1` for dimensionless, `mm`, `deg`, `mm^2`, `mm^-1`, `mm*deg`, ...), and `value`: `bits` (IEEE-754 binary64, big-endian hex) when the result is exactly specified, or `tolerance_rel` when it goes through libm (non-table trigonometry, hypot, non-integer powers). `error` gives `code` and `stage` (`R` rejected at validation, `E` evaluation error); stage-E cases also give `canonical` and `type`. Generated by an independent Python reference implementation; consumed by W1 (Rust), W7 (Python) and W8 (TypeScript: parse, canonical, type only).
